caption: Figure 7. Time-resolved latency profiles for four monitored runtime paths during the Supermarket marker-only baseline configuration. (a) EyeTracking→PC; (b) MoCap→PC; (c) MoCap→VR; (d) PC–VR shared-state RTT. Thin gray lines show each Participant’s time-binned median, while the colored line and shaded band show the across-participant median and interquartile range (). The three high-rate paths use 1-s bins and the PC–VR shared-state RTT uses 5-s bins. Samples within ±250 ms of identified garbage-collection (GC) events are removed only from EyeTracking→PC and MoCap→PC; all other tail observations are retained.

caption: Figure 7. Time-resolved latency profiles for four monitored runtime paths during the Supermarket marker-only baseline configuration. (a) EyeTracking→PC; (b) MoCap→PC; (c) MoCap→VR; (d) PC–VR shared-state RTT. Thin gray lines show each Participant’s time-binned median, while the colored line and shaded band show the across-participant median and interquartile range ().
